news.title: ‘Place to Be’ Review: Ellen Burstyn Is Radiant in Otherwise Lackluster Late-Life Drama
news.description: Venice: The latest small-scale drama from director Kornél Mundruczó is a simple affair, but the luminous Ellen Burstyn makes it a watchable one.

news.title: It's 2031, and the U.S. has 'come undone' in Emily St. John Mandel's 'Exit Party'
news.description: Exit Party presents an arresting vision of a world in which time is porous and people are duplicated. Like Mandel's prior novels, it's ingenious, eerie and complex — and it hits close to home.
